Lionel Richie Hospitalized After St. Louis Concert

Singer Lionel Richie was hospitalized in St. Louis following a concert. Sources indicated he was being evaluated for possible slight dehydration. The hospitalization occurred after a summer marked by health concerns and canceled performances.
